2121918080293196209.en_summary: aleabitoreddit shares the most interesting lesson Jensen Huang taught and gave PTSD to Google executives from leadership at $NVDA: if a critical material can be bought out for spare change e.g. ~$400m (FY2028 Photonics-SOI revenue forecast for $SOI) and trigger tens of billions in economic impact to competitors for not securing supply. Sees game theory bottleneck supply procurement accelerate upstream through 2027 with or without him. Quotes Morgan Stanley on next investment themes in upstream materials like ABF, CCL, PCB. Focuses on smaller component cost chokepoints. Notes deleveraging/negative sentiment moving theme indiscriminately. Opportunities in bottlenecks as new architectures like NPO/CPO emerge.
2121918080293196209.zh_summary: aleabitoreddit分享Jensen Huang教給他最有趣的教訓，並從$NVDA領導中給Google高管PTSD：如果關鍵材料可以用零花錢買斷例如約4億美元（$SOI的FY2028光子學-SOI收入預測），並因未能確保供應而對競爭對手造成數十億美元經濟影響。看到博弈論瓶頸供應採購在2027年加速向上游，無論有無他。引用摩根士丹利關於上游材料如ABF、CCL、PCB的下一輪投資主題。專注於較小組件成本瓶頸。指出去槓桿/負面情緒不分青紅皂白移動主題。隨著NPO/CPO等新架構出現，瓶頸中有許多超額機會。

ticker_notes.SOI: 約4億美元可買斷關鍵材料，影響競爭對手數十億
